blocks.text: while loop tab tak chalta rehta hai jab tak shart sach ho. Har chakkar (iteration) se pehle shart check hoti hai, aur shart jhoot hote hi loop ruk jata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab ke syntax mein "while condition:" pehli comment line ke aakhir mein chhap gaya hai. Asal shakal oopar hai: while condition: aur us ke neeche indented code.
Misaal: number mein 1 jorte jayein jab tak woh 10 tak na pohanche.

Wazahat: number pehle 1 hai. Loop check karta hai ke number 10 se kam hai ya nahi. Kam ho to number print hota hai aur phir us mein 1 jor diya jata hai. Jab number 10 ho jata hai to shart jhoot ho jati hai aur loop ruk jata hai. Is liye screen par 1 se 9 tak adad aate hain (10 print nahi hota).

blocks.alt: Flowchart: number = 1, phir sawal number < 10?. True ho to print(number), phir number += 1, aur baen taraf ki lakeer wapas sawal par le jati hai. False ho to daen taraf Loop khatam (1 se 9 print ho chuke).
blocks.caption: while loop ka bahao: shart sach rehne tak chakkar (number < 10 misal ka asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: while loop se Python program likhein jo 1 se 20 tak even (juft) adad print kare aur odd (taaq) adad gine.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: 1 se 20 tak even adad print karein aur odd adad ginein.
blocks.explanation: n = 1; count = 0; while n <= 20: (andar) if n % 2 == 0: print(n) else: count += 1; phir n += 1. Loop ke baad print("Odd numbers:", count). Yeh 2, 4, ..., 20 print karta hai aur 10 odd adad ginta hai.

blocks.prompt: while loop likhein jo 1 se 20 tak taaq adad print kare aur gine (long question 6; class activity).
blocks.explanation: n = 1; count = 0; while n <= 20: if n % 2 == 1: print(n); count += 1 (if ke andar); n += 1 (loop ke andar); aakhir mein print("Total odd numbers:", count), jo 10 print karta hai.

items: while: shart sach rehne tak dohrata hai; number += 1 na ho to loop kabhi na ruke.
Misaal 1 se 9 tak print karti hai.
